long_biography.plain_text:
BW Group grew from World-Wide Shipping, founded in Hong Kong by Sohmen-Pao's maternal grandfather, Y.K. Pao, and later led by his parents' generation. After studying Oriental Studies at Oxford and earning an MBA from Harvard, he joined the business in 1999. He became group chief executive before succeeding his father as chairman in 2014. That progression made him an active successor rather than a passive heir.

Today Sohmen-Pao chairs BW Group and listed affiliates spanning product and gas tanker shipping, offshore energy and wind-vessel installation. BW Group is family controlled, and a trust under his control anchors that relationship. He is also sole shareholder of a vehicle holding Cadeler shares, though its board controls voting and investment decisions. His wealth therefore rests on an inherited maritime platform that he has operated and broadened into energy-transition infrastructure. The family fortune and corporate fleets are not his direct personal assets, and his individual share of family wealth remains undisclosed.
